sentences.text: 2 10-02-2021 Mr. Suman Kumar Jha, learned AC to AAG-3 has appeared on behalf of the State respondents.
Learned counsel submits that since the copy of the writ application has been served upon him only day before yesterday, he has yet to seek instruction in the matter and file an appropriate affidavit.
As prayed by him, two weeks' time is granted to seek instruction and file an affidavit in a position.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn the attention of this Court towards the judgment and order dated 19.07.2016 passed by Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court in CWJC No. 3805 of 2015 and other analogues matter wherein the Hon'ble Division Bench has been pleased to observe as under:-
"135. COTPA, being a parent legislation, is the Patna High Court CR.
WJC No.408 of 2020(2) dt.10-02-2021 comprehensive law, which deals with the sale, manufacture and production of tobacco and tobacco products notified in the Schedule of the COTPA.

136. Regulation 2.3.4 of Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Brahma Trading Company Through Its ... vs The State Of Bihar Through The ... on 10 February, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69849127/
1 Sales) Regulations, 2011, which prohibits use of tobacco and nicotine with respect to Scheduled tobacco and tobacco products under COTPA, must yield to the COTPA."

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that in a similar matter a learned Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has vide judgment dated 01.06.2016 passed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 551 of 2016 held that the very seizure and institution of the First Information Report and all the subsequent acts were wholly without jurisdiction and those were quashed with a direction to release the truck of the petitioner with all the goods.

Similar order has been passed by another learned Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 11.05.2017 in Cr.W.J.C. No. 481 of 2017 as regards release of the goods which were of identical nature, subject, however, to the submission of the surety bond of Rs.5 lakhs.
Learned counsel submits that in the present case also the petitioner is ready to submit sufficient security and as such this Court may consider release of the goods.
WJC No.408 of 2020(2) dt.10-02-2021 Learned counsel for the State shall seek instruction on the aforesaid issue as well and assist this Court on the next date.
List this case after two weeks i.e. on 25 th February, 2021.

(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) SUSHMA2/-
U Note:
The ordersheet duly signed has been attached with the record.

However, in view of the present arrangements, during Pandemic period all concerned shall act on the basis of the copy of the order uploaded on the High Court website under the heading 'Judicial Orders Passed During The Pandemic Period'.
